title: Even visible, another bot is never something to answer

beats.text: olisar, playback has stopped. respond to confirm you received this.

notes: Two bots answering each other is an unbounded loop, and with see_other_bots on the only thing preventing it is that a bot author never reaches the trigger path. Beat 2 addresses Olisar by name and asks for a reply, which would sail through every other gate — the author check is the whole defence, so it gets its own case. The 70s wait also covers proactivity: a chime here is the same loop by a different route.
